game.name: OpenGlad
game.author: OpenGlad project (GPL-2.0); L33TEST Crossroads integration
game.description: A real-time action RPG in the gladiator-arena tradition. Recruit and grow a Company of fighters across classes, through campaigns of combat and progression. Play solo, or host a match and have another player join to fight alongside or against you, right in your browser. Your Company saves to your own L33TEST account.
